limits: Kernel/copy/memset/graph interval unions avoid overlap double counting. API wait time overlaps device activity and must not be added.
Remaining range time includes CPU physics/topology/clipping and bisection tails, compilation, dispatch, waits or gaps; fractions are not separately established by this timeline.
Copy duration includes latency; no isolated critical bandwidth fraction, GPU DRAM bytes, cache, occupancy/stalls or achieved FP64 counters. No2x/4xhardware bandwidth/compute speedup predicted.
CPU markers cover the original boundary precision field only. Other CPU preparation remain mixed with dispatch and synchronization outside these ranges.

timing_scope: Two finite curves per candidate, changing physical proposals, original mapping/density and accuracy checks including host work, transfers, synchronization, compilation as encountered and returned curves. Coarse timing uses donor cap 0 so grouping is exercised. B1 has three changed warm samples and B4/B8 one per process. Fine matched cold CPU/GPU costs use the same affinity and thread limits. Supplemental CPU-only JAX B1/B8 use lower scheduling priority. Source hashes are per bounded window. CPU-only fine reference calculations could overlap bounded runs on SMT siblings, including part of the B4 benchmark. The B8 unprofiled pair ran after these CPU references. Two independent diagnostic/test files were added before the final windows; the timed kernels are identical.
